dashboard.title: Home

detail.title: Album overview

readyPage.pendingDescription: The server must confirm setup and return the activation result before this album can be marked ready.
readyPage.paymentPendingDescription: The server returned PAYMENT_PENDING. The current setup flow cannot resolve this status.

guestLimit.description: Set how many photos each participant can submit. This is not a participant count or the album's total capacity.
guestLimit.label: Photos per participant

guestLimit.error: Settings could not be saved. Try again.
guestLimit.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
guestLimit.forbiddenDescription: This account cannot set up this album.

collaborators.title: Invite a collaborator
collaborators.description: Grant setup, moderation, or export access independently as needed.

collaborators.error: The invitation could not be created. Try again.
collaborators.empty: No invitations have been recorded yet.
collaborators.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
collaborators.forbiddenDescription: This account cannot set up this album.

accessPin.description: An album PIN is optional. Guests do not need to create an account to access an album.
accessPin.label: Album PIN

accessPin.error: The PIN could not be saved. Try again.
accessPin.forbiddenDescription: This account cannot set up this album.

design.title: Album cover

packages.selectionIsDraft: Changing this selection does not grant paid quota.
